capabilities: Chat with local or hosted AI models from one provider dropdown
Attach notes and folders as composable context with a token budget and inspector
Apply AI-proposed edits, creations, renames and deletions as reviewable plans with undo
Search vault notes in natural language via indexed agent tools
Branch conversations by editing or regenerating messages
extras: Manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README warns that Claude Code OAuth tokens (sk-ant-oat01-...) do not work and that using them in third-party tools violates Anthropic's terms.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, and existing AI plugins typically default to hosted API keys and apply model changes without per-edit review or undo.

relations.evidence: Tested with Ollama and LM Studio; llama.cpp, vLLM, LocalAI, and Jan expose the same API
Tested with Ollama and LM Studio; llama.cpp, vLLM, LocalAI, and Jan expose the same API

requires.name: Ollama or any OpenAI-compatible local server

summary: Local-first multi-provider AI chat that reads vault files and applies note edits, creations and deletions through reviewable, undoable plans.
